description: [phase 3.8 38c, kind `scope`] showCourseReport calls slot 0x9c of the live display object (arguments 1, 1, 1) at entry when the display pointer is set. The port drops it as an engine call; the oracle stubs the slot with a routine that writes nothing, so it proves the exe-side writes only. Whether jgld writes any exe .data object from that slot is not determined (the display object itself is heap, outside every image).

[phase 3.8 38c, kind `oracle`] showEndOfYearScreen calls loadStoryStrings(subject, -1, 0, 0) for event kind 0x120 and landmarkName(subject, 0) for kind 0x160 while building the highlight lines. The oracle records loadStoryStrings on both sides (file I/O) and runs landmarkName for real on the original, but the port masks g_textBuffer, which both write, so what they leave in the text buffer is not compared; no other write of either call is known.
